 Read more Read less When it comes to beauty inspiration, Kate Middleton rarely disappoints. Whether attending a royal engagement, walking the red carpet, or appearing at an international event, the Princess of Wales keeps her makeup elegant, polished, and effortlessly wearable. However, for the 2026 Earthshot Prize Awards in Mumbai, she appeared to turn up the glamour with a beauty look that beautifully complemented the occasion.
 Held on November 17, 2026, in Mumbai, the awards ceremony saw Kate step out in a stunning vermilion-red Anarkali by Indian designer Mahima Mahajan. While her outfit celebrated Indian craftsmanship, her makeup offered an interesting departure from her usual understated beauty choices. She opted for more defined eyes, a warmer complexion, a noticeable blush and soft, glossy lips. The result was a look that brought together her signature elegance and elements of Indian evening makeup.
 Here's a closer look at the makeup details worth taking inspiration from.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by The Prince and Princess of Wales (@princeandprincessofwales) 
 Smoky eyes with earthy undertones
 The most noticeable feature of Kate's Earthshot Prize makeup was her eye look. Instead of sticking entirely to her familiar soft, neutral eye makeup, she embraced a more defined, smoky finish.
 Her eyelids appeared to feature earthy brown shades with subtle plum undertones, adding depth and dimension to the eyes. A hint of peachy-champagne shimmer across the lids brought a reflective finish, making the eye makeup look more festive without appearing too heavy.
 The eyeliner was another important detail. Defined along both the upper and lower lash lines, it gave her eyes a beautifully framed appearance. Her lashes also looked fuller, particularly towards the outer corners, creating a subtle lifted effect.
 What makes this eye makeup particularly interesting is its versatility. You can recreate a similar look for weddings, festive celebrations and evening parties by blending brown and plum eyeshadows, adding a touch of shimmer to the centre of the lids and finishing with black or deep brown eyeliner.
 Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Warm, rosy-peach blush for a healthy flush
 Kate's complexion had a lovely warmth to it, thanks to the peachy-rose blush that added colour to her cheeks. Unlike a barely-there flush, this application was more noticeable and gave her face a fresh, healthy-looking appearance.
 The blush worked particularly well with her red Anarkali, balancing the richness of the outfit without competing with its intricate embroidery.
 There also appeared to be a subtle bronzed effect around her complexion, adding warmth and definition. Rather than opting for an overly sculpted contour, the overall finish looked soft and blended.
 If you want to recreate this look, choose a warm peach, rosy nude or muted terracotta blush. Apply it to the apples of your cheeks and blend towards the temples for a naturally lifted appearance. A light layer of bronzer can further add warmth.
 Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Luminous skin with a natural-looking finish
 Another detail worth noticing was the overall finish of Kate's base makeup. Her complexion looked radiant, with a soft, luminous quality rather than an excessively matte or heavily powdered appearance.
 The idea behind this kind of base makeup is to allow the skin to look fresh while providing enough coverage to create an even complexion. A lightweight foundation or skin tint, followed by concealer where needed, can help achieve a similar effect.
 A little strategic highlighting on the high points of the face can also add dimension. The key is to maintain balance so that the complexion looks radiant rather than overly shiny.
 Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Soft glossy lips keep the look balanced
 With her eyes and cheeks taking centre stage, Kate kept her lip makeup relatively understated. Her lips featured a soft peachy-pink shade with a delicate glossy finish.
 This was a clever beauty choice. A bold red lipstick might have competed with her vermilion outfit, while a completely nude lip could have made the overall makeup appear less defined. The peachy-pink colour added just enough freshness and complemented the warmer tones across her face.
 For a similar finish, choose a rosy-pink or peach-toned lipstick and layer a clear or lightly tinted gloss over it. This combination works particularly well when you want your eye makeup to remain the focal point.
 Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... Loading Suggestions... A half-up hairstyle completes the beauty look
 Kate finished her appearance with a half-up, half-down hairstyle that allowed her glossy lengths to frame her face. The hairstyle added softness to the overall look and complemented the elaborate detailing of her Anarkali.
 Together, the hairstyle and makeup created a beautiful balance between traditional Indian-inspired glamour and her familiar royal beauty aesthetic.
 Tips to get a natural, flushed look
 A natural, flushed look is all about adding a soft hint of colour to your cheeks and lips while keeping your skin looking fresh, healthy and radiant. The idea is to recreate the subtle rosy glow you get after a brisk walk, without making your makeup look too heavy. Here are some easy tips to achieve this look.
 Start with well-hydrated skin 
 Healthy-looking makeup begins with good skin preparation. Apply a lightweight moisturiser to keep your skin hydrated and supple. Well-moisturised skin helps makeup blend seamlessly and gives your complexion a naturally dewy finish.
 Choose a lightweight base 
 Skip heavy foundations and opt for a tinted moisturiser, BB cream or lightweight skin tint. These products even out your complexion while allowing your natural skin texture to show through. Use concealer only where needed to maintain a fresh, skin-like finish.
 Pick the right blush shade 
 Choose blush colours that complement your natural undertone. Soft pink, peach, rose and coral shades work beautifully for a flushed appearance. If you have a deeper skin tone, try berry, terracotta or warm plum shades for a natural-looking pop of colour.
 Opt for cream or liquid blush 
 Cream and liquid blushes are excellent choices for achieving a natural flush. They melt into the skin and create a soft, skin-like finish. Dab a small amount onto the apples of your cheeks and blend upwards towards your cheekbones using your fingertips or a damp makeup sponge.
